page.title: Bot inbox
page.intro: Your bot's own mailbox. Mail that comes in is outside data: your agents can read it, but never take orders from it. Every email they want to send asks you first.

setup.title: Connect a mailbox
setup.intro: You make the mailbox yourself, at any provider you choose, in your own browser.
setup.step1: Create a new mailbox for your bot at the provider of your choice.
setup.step2: In that mailbox's settings, turn on IMAP and SMTP and make an app password. Check your provider's terms (some need a helper app for IMAP).
setup.step3: Enter the server details and the app password below.
setup.never: PasaBot never creates a mailbox, never signs in through a browser for you and never solves captchas. The details and the app password are kept in the vault only.
setup.usernameHint: Leave empty when it is the email address.
setup.passwordHint: The app password your provider made for this bot, not your main password.
setup.passwordKeep: Saved in the vault. Leave empty to keep it.
setup.saved: Saved. The details and the app password are in the vault.

mail.title: Mail
mail.intro: Shown as plain text. Pictures and links in mail are never loaded.
mail.wasHtml: This mail was formatted; it is shown here as plain text.

bridge.title: Pair with another PasaBot
bridge.intro: Two bots can write to each other by email. Exchange the address and key below with the other owner (in person or another way you trust). Their messages still count as outside data, and every reply asks you first.
bridge.peerKeyHint: The key the other owner sees on their Inbox page.

page.intro: Your bot's own mailbox. Mail that comes in is from outside: your helpers can read it, but never take orders from it. Every email they want to send asks you first.

setup.intro: You make the mailbox yourself, at any email company you choose, in your own browser.
setup.step1: Make a new mailbox for your bot at the email company you choose.
setup.step2: In that mailbox's settings, turn on access for mail apps and make an app password. Check your email company's rules (some need a helper app for this).
setup.step3: Type the mail details and the app password below.
setup.never: PasaBot never makes a mailbox, never signs in through a browser for you and never solves captchas. The details and the app password are kept safe on this computer only.
setup.passwordHint: The app password your email company made for this bot, not your main password.
setup.passwordKeep: Kept safe on this computer. Leave empty to keep it.
setup.saved: Saved. The details and the app password are kept safe on this computer.

error.bad_host: That incoming or outgoing mail address does not look right.
error.blocked_address: That address is on a private or blocked network, so PasaBot will not connect to it.
error.host_not_allowed: That is not an address you typed.
error.starttls_unavailable: The mail service did not offer a secure connection, so PasaBot did not sign in.
error.tls_failed: The mail service's safety certificate could not be checked.
error.auth_failed: The mail service refused the sign-in. Check the app password.
error.timeout: The mail service did not answer.

manual.intro: Your mail service's help pages list these details (look for the settings for mail apps). Use an app password if it offers one.

guide.moved: This email setup moved on. You can pick it up in Settings, under Your mailbox.
guide.badAddress: That doesn't look like an email address. Check it and try again.

ideas.title: Address ideas
ideas.note: These are only ideas. Google tells you which ones are free when you sign up.
ideas.nameHint: Like Reyes Hardware. I'll make a few address ideas from it.

signup.title: Make the account at Gmail
signup.ask2: the new address you want (an idea above is fine)
signup.ask3: a password you choose and keep safe. I never see it
signup.ask4: a phone check: Google texts you a code
signup.onlyYou: Only you do this part, in your own browser. I never sign up, type your password or answer the phone check for you.
signup.done: Done, I have my new email

address.label: Your email address
address.work: Is this a work or school email? Whoever manages it may need to allow app passwords first. Ask them if your code keeps being refused.

apppw.title: Make an app password for PasaBot
apppw.why: An app password is a special code that {{company}} makes just for PasaBot. I use it instead of your real password, and you can remove it any time.
apppw.s1: Turn on 2-step verification if it is off. {{company}} asks for this before it makes app passwords, and sends a code to your phone.

s2.gmail: On Google's App passwords page, type PasaBot as the name and tap Create.
s2.outlook: On Microsoft's security page, choose “Create a new app password”.
s2.yahoo: On Yahoo's account security page, tap “Generate app password”, type PasaBot and tap Generate.
s2.icloud: On Apple's account page, open Sign-In and Security, then App-Specific Passwords. Tap the plus button and type PasaBot.

apppw.s3: Copy the code it shows: {{letters}} letters, in small groups. Then come back here.

code.title: Paste your code
code.label: App password ({{letters}} letters)
code.hint: Spaces are fine. Paste it only here, never in a chat.
code.ok: Connected. I can now read and draft for you.

reason.wrong_code: {{company}} said no to that code. Make a new app password and paste the {{letters}} letters again.
reason.two_step_off: {{company}} wants 2-step verification turned on first. Turn it on, make a new app password, then paste it here.
reason.imap_off: {{company}} isn't letting mail apps into this account. If a company or school manages it, ask them to allow mail apps. Then tap Connect again. Your code is still in the box.
reason.no_internet: I couldn't reach {{company}}. Check that this computer is online, then try again.
reason.server_trouble: {{company}}'s mail server didn't answer safely. Wait a minute and try again.
reason.code_shape: That isn't {{letters}} letters. Copy the code again from {{company}}'s page.
reason.stopped: Everything is stopped right now. Turn it back on, then try again.
reason.tooMany: That's a lot of tries in a row. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
reason.busy: Still checking your last try. Wait a moment.

manual.intro: Your mail service's help pages list these details (look for IMAP and SMTP). Use an app password if it offers one.
manual.plain: For other email services, tell {{name}} in the chat which company runs your email. They'll help you find its settings. To type them in, turn on Technical words in Settings.
manual.plainNoName: For other email services, tell your helper in the chat which company runs your email. They'll help you find its settings. To type them in, turn on Technical words in Settings.

access.title: What may your helpers do with this email?
access.readHint: They read and sort your mail. Nothing is written or sent.
access.draftHint: They read your mail and write replies for you to check. Nothing is sent.
access.sendHint: They may send email, but only after you tap Approve, every time.

test.title: A tiny test
test.body: Send an email to {{address}} with this word in the subject. From your phone is fine. I'll show you when it arrives.
test.none: Nothing with the word {{word}} yet. Mail can take a minute, so try again soon.
test.proves: This shows I can read your inbox.

finished.title: Your email is connected
finished.draft: Your helpers can read it and draft replies for you.
finished.send: Your helpers can read it, draft replies, and send after you approve.
finished.change: You can change this any time in Settings, under Your mailbox.

say.introNew: Let's make your team's new email together. I'll go one step at a time; tap the button at the end of each step when you're ready.
say.introConnect: Let's connect your email. It takes about 3 minutes, one step at a time.
say.service: First, which email do you use?
say.ideas: First, what's your business or team called? I'll suggest a few addresses.
say.signup: Now open Gmail sign-up and make the account. Tap Done when you see your new inbox.
say.address_new: Nice! Type your new address here.
say.guide: Now we make a special code for me, so I never need your password.
say.code: Paste the code here. I'll check it with {{company}}.
say.manual: Type the server details your mail service gives.
say.access: Connected! What may your helpers do with it?
say.manualPlain: Which company runs your email? Tell me in the chat and I'll help find its settings.

withMe.mine: I’ll do it in my own browser
withMe.intro: {{name}} opens the sign-up page in its own browser and fills in your name and the address you pick. You do the password and the phone check.
withMe.badName: Type your first and last name.
withMe.noBrowser: {{name}}’s browser couldn’t start here. Do it in your own browser instead.
withMe.yourTurn: Your turn: choose a password and do the phone check. I can’t see or type these.
withMe.yourTurnText: Tap Take over to use the browser. Tap Done when your new email is made.
withMe.wait: The picture shows up in a moment…
withMe.taken: You’re using the browser now. {{name}} can’t see or do anything in it.
withMe.settled: Signed up. Next: your new address
withMe.settledMine: Doing it in your own browser
